open_items.text: ops/loop/ledger.py has no test module of its own - confirm and close the gap

A lane adding a NEW file cannot go green alone - the orphan guard needs ownership declared in ops/lanes.py, which the ops lane owns. Measured on lane/ingest with savewatch.py. Decide: ops declares ownership first, or the integrator declares it at merge
lanes/<id>.LEDGER.md fragments are created lazily on first entry, so six of seven lanes have no fragment yet and the git-visibility guard skips a file that does not exist

The git-visibility guard skips paths that do not exist, so with fragments created lazily it currently checks exactly one real fragment. It also cannot catch an ignore rule added after a file is already tracked

Decide whether ledger ids become per-lane namespaced (SAF-NNNN style, collision-free by construction) and the global LL-NNNN space is retired. Detection now catches a collision, so this is no longer urgent - but retiring the global space changes what 30 existing entries, and every roadmap item and branch citing an LL id, refer to. Operator decision

lane_state.integrate() catches FileNotFoundError and NotADirectoryError to return [] for a missing fragment, but a path that IS a directory raises a bare PermissionError on Windows (errno 13) instead of a clear message. Hit by calling integrate('ops') with a lane id instead of a fragment path. Caller error, but the error should name the mistake

integrate() raises forever on any entry EDITED after it was integrated into docs/LEDGER.md, because the entry then differs from its fragment, and the live collision test stays red until they are reconciled by hand. Found by the 2c adversarial pass. Decide whether an integrated entry is simply never edited (policy) or whether the fragment should be reconciled automatically (code)

The heading GUARD respects code fences but the heading PARSER does not: _assert_headings_parse skips fenced lines while _HEADING_RE.finditer runs over the whole entry region, so a WELL-FORMED heading inside a code block is parsed as a real entry while a malformed one beside it is ignored. Found while writing the tilde-fence test in the 2026-08-12 wrap. Decide whether _blocks_below should share the fence scanner

resume_note: ROADMAP 2d closed on lane/ops - the contract names no absolute path, so a fresh clone runs 957 green. OPS-4 closed. OPS-6 (per-lane id namespacing) is still an operator decision, recorded not taken
